categories.title: Books and reading resources
categories.status_label: Original reading guidance is available; Tajkart does not host the linked books.
categories.summary: Learn how to choose, read, cite, and practise from material you lawfully access.

categories.title: Courses and structured learning paths
categories.status_label: Six original self-study plans are available; they remain drafts pending expert review.
categories.summary: Choose a sequenced study plan with objectives, practice, projects, and completion checks.

categories.title: Academic subjects
categories.status_label: A mapped subject index and short English mathematics paths are available; most mapped topics are not full courses.
categories.summary: Explore the current subject map and see which topics have original lessons today.

categories.title: Programming languages
categories.status_label: Eleven introductory language paths are available; none is a complete language curriculum.
categories.summary: Compare language starting points and follow the linked beginner study sequence.

categories.title: Computer science and IT
categories.status_label: Twelve original computing subject guides and related lessons are available; coverage is incomplete.
categories.summary: Start with programming, algorithms, databases, networks, operating systems, security, and software practice.

categories.title: Mathematics and statistics
categories.status_label: Short arithmetic, proportional reasoning, data interpretation, and algebra drafts are available; educator review is pending.
categories.summary: Follow the current foundations sequence and check the content progress report for its limits.

categories.title: Science and engineering
categories.status_label: No original science or engineering course is currently authored.
categories.summary: This area is reserved for complete, reviewed learning units rather than placeholder course claims.

categories.title: Business, economics, and humanities
categories.status_label: No original course in these subject areas is currently authored.
categories.summary: New material will be added when a coherent, student-reviewed unit is ready.

categories.title: Tutorials and interactive learning
categories.status_label: Two original browser activities are available; they use fixed questions and do not execute learner code.
categories.summary: Use prediction and code-reading activities for formative practice.

categories.title: Practice questions and worked solutions
categories.status_label: Eleven original problem sets contain 30 questions with written solutions and question-specific test evidence; human review is pending.
categories.summary: Attempt a task, use a hint, compare with the explanation, and revisit prerequisites when needed.

categories.title: Cheatsheets and revision notes
categories.status_label: Ten original computing cheatsheets are available as drafts pending technical review.
categories.summary: Use short references to revisit concepts after studying the full explanation.

categories.title: Projects and portfolio building
categories.status_label: Seven original project briefs are available; they are specifications, not finished applications.
categories.summary: Choose a small deliverable, work through milestones, test it, and record evidence of your work.

categories.title: Educational podcasts and screencasts
categories.status_label: Original guidance is available; no external channel or episode has been reviewed as a recommendation.
categories.summary: Learn how to take notes from media and verify a source before relying on it.

categories.title: Coding playgrounds and practical tools
categories.status_label: Tajkart does not host a code runner; external playground candidates are unverified.
categories.summary: Use the candidate search only to discover source-listed destinations; inspect each provider and its terms independently.

categories.title: Career preparation
categories.status_label: Five original career guides are available; role-specific advice needs human review.
categories.summary: Prepare a resume, interview, internship application, professional email, and entry-level learning plan.

categories.title: Scholarships, internships, and opportunities
categories.status_label: No live opportunity listings are currently published.
categories.summary: Listings require current source, eligibility, date, attribution, and terms checks before publication.

categories.title: Study skills and student productivity
categories.status_label: One original study-skills guide is available as a draft pending review.
categories.summary: Use practical study sessions, retrieval, practice, and assignment planning techniques.

categories.title: Languages and translated learning resources
categories.status_label: Eleven introductory programming paths and two pending Hindi/Urdu translation drafts are available.
categories.summary: The source-list locale of an external candidate does not prove the linked work's language.
